summary.en-US: YouTube videos pick up where you left off, even when you click a thumbnail after its preview.

description.en-US:
Ever clicked a YouTube video and it started over from the beginning? This add-on fixes that.

- **Watched a few seconds of a video by hovering over it?** Click it, and it keeps playing from there. (Chrome already does this. Firefox doesn't.)
- **Stopped a video halfway?** Open it again later, and it picks up right where you stopped.

You can choose how long it remembers your videos: 15 days by default.

No account needed. Nothing leaves your computer.
